Priti International Ltd. | Indian Solid Wood Furniture Manufacturer for Global B2B Buyers

Transforming Spaces. Inspiring Lifestyles.

At Priti International, we craft more than furniture — we create experiences. As a global handcrafted furniture exporter from India, we bring warmth, design, and durability to homes, hotels, and resorts across the world.

Our products combine traditional Indian craftsmanship with modern, sustainable design — making every piece timeless and globally admired.

Luxury Handcrafted Furniture for Global Homes and Hospitality

Discover our world of design excellence.
At Priti International, our artisans handcraft furniture using solid mango wood, sheesham, acacia, and reclaimed wood, ensuring beauty and strength in every detail.

We serve global buyers, importers, and interior designers, providing premium Indian furniture with international finishing and export-grade quality.

Living Room Furniture – Designed for Comfort and Style

Make your living room a reflection of your personality. Explore our range of luxury sofas, sectionals, recliners, coffee tables, side tables, and stools handcrafted from solid wood and metal.

Each design combines global trends with Indian artistry, creating a space that’s both stylish and inviting.

Dining Furniture – Timeless Craftsmanship, Everyday Comfort

Redefine dining with our exquisite wooden dining tables, chairs, and sideboards. Perfect for hotels, resorts, restaurants, or your dream home.

Our dining collection blends classic elegance and modern function, designed to elevate every meal into a memory.

Bedroom Furniture – Elegant, Durable, and Serene

Experience ultimate relaxation with our handcrafted beds, dressers, wardrobes, and bedside tables.

Every piece reflects a commitment to solid wood craftsmanship, combining comfort with timeless design — ideal for residential and hospitality projects worldwide.

Office & Study Furniture – Smart Design for Modern Workspaces

Create a workspace that inspires creativity. Our office desks, ergonomic chairs, and bookcases blend functionality with elegant form.

Built from sustainable materials, these pieces are perfect for corporate offices, co-working spaces, and home workstations.

Bar & Entertainment Furniture – Style Meets Functionality

Entertain with elegance. Our bar counters, bar stools, and wine racks add sophistication and practicality to your entertainment spaces.

Crafted with precision, these pieces serve as the focal point of luxury lounges, resorts, and homes.

Home Decor & Accessories – Artistic Details for Global Interiors

Complete your space with handcrafted décor — mirrors, wall art, sculptures, and console tables that add personality and warmth.

Each piece reflects Indian heritage and modern aesthetics — blending seamlessly into global interiors.

Sustainable Furniture – The PRI-Cycle Collection

Join the movement toward eco-friendly living with Priti International’s PRI-Cycle Collection — a range of furniture crafted from recycled wood, reclaimed metal, and sustainable materials.

Designed for conscious consumers, each product supports a greener planet without compromising style.

Global Reach, Local Craftsmanship

With decades of export expertise, Priti International serves buyers across the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Our Jodhpur-based factory delivers custom furniture for hospitality projects, retailers, and interior designers, ensuring world-class quality with Indian craftsmanship.

Why Global Buyers Choose Priti International

✅ Over 20 years of manufacturing and export expertise
✅ 100% in-house production and design control
✅ Sustainable sourcing and certified materials
✅ Trusted by luxury hotels, resorts, and global retailers
✅ Flexible customization and private labeling options

Explore. Customize. Export.

Bring your vision to life with Priti International.
Explore our collections online and discover why global buyers trust India’s leading handcrafted furniture brand.
